item.title: About Adno
item.description: Adno is led by the Espace Mendès France a center for scientific, technical and industrial culture located in Poitiers and which operates throughout the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region (France). It is developing in partnership with Abbey of Saint-Savin-sur-Gartempe and the valley of frescoes, the Bibliothèque Sainte-Geneviève, Paris, the Cité internationale de la bande dessinée et de l’image, Angoulême, the Museums of Poitiers, the Natural History Museum of La Rochelle. Adno was selected as one of the sixteen winners of the 2022 edition of the call for innovative digital services projects by the french Ministry of Culture.

item.title: Quick Start
item.description: An online application # The easiest way to get started is to use the online instance of Adno. It is free and does not require registration. You can also start from one of the examples provided on this site. Get started! Examples Adno is free software, which means you can use, study, modify, adapt it to your own needs and redistribute it under the terms of the MIT license. You can therefore install it for yourself and for others.
